_comment: Single source of truth for the ROS 2 distributions this project ships. Read by .github/workflows/server_tests.yml, .github/workflows/docker_image.yml (via scripts/plan_images.py) and checked against the README grid by scripts/tests/test_plan_images.py. status: supported (LTS: tested, must pass, immutable release tags) | experimental (Rolling: tested, allowed to fail, floating tags only). default: the distro used in docs, server.json and catalog examples. latest: the distro the :latest tag points at (newest LTS).
